verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers 2FAS Auth (TOTP/HOTP/Steam Guard codes) and 2FAS Pass (password storage, sharing, browser extension autofill) but contains no mention of passkey (WebAuthn/FIDO2) storage or passkey-based sign-in anywhere. Passkey support is a fair capability to expect from a password manager, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows it exists.
